name: anhedral
description: Scaffold Next.js with Anhedral UI and progressively add selected APIs, data, clients, payments, realtime and AI.

interface.longDescription: Start with one Next.js app and source-owned Anhedral UI. Add Hono, Drizzle/D1/Better Auth, storage, payments, realtime, AI, Expo, WXT/Side Panel or GPUI through explicit protected source recipes. No provider provisioning or deployment is performed.
defaultPrompt: Initialize an application with the Anhedral stack, start it locally and open it in my browser.
